description: cuda: guard the iq4_nl dequantize row kernel against short rows ( #29683 ) dequantize_block_iq4_nl writes QK_K values per block, but a row can be shorter than that (an IQ4_NL row is only guaranteed to be a multiple of QK4_NL). title: b11302
description: glm5-next: give dead indexer slots unique scatter rows ( #29745 ) The sparse indexer mask is built with a set_rows scatter. Padded pools, absent sequences and missing tail cells all pointed to the same n_kv sentinel row, and invisible pools picked by top_k to fill the selection overlap the tail cells of the token, so several CPU threads wrote the same element (ThreadSanitizer data race in the sanitize CI). Allocate the slot mask for both selection paths and route every dead slot to its own dump
